summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a $500 million offering of 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations with no subsidiary guarantees. Interest is payable semiannually at 5.750% per annum, maturing May 15, 2036. Optional redemption is permitted; a change-of-control repurchase event triggers a 101% repurchase offer. The notes will not be listed on any exchange. Use of proceeds is not specified. Joint book-running managers include J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Morgan Stanley, and others. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
